sanskrit_verse: अपराधानुरूपश् च दण्डोऽत्र परिकल्पितः । साक्षिलेख्यानुमानेन सम्यग् दिव्येन वा जितः ॥
transliteration: aparādhānurūpaś ca daṇḍo 'tra parikalpitaḥ / sākṣilekhyānumānena samyag divyena vā jitaḥ //
sph_interpretive_translation: The measure of consequence is precisely aligned with the nature of the misalignment; it is determined through direct witness, documented evidence, inference, or divine discernment.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates solely from SPH as the ultimate source of dharma
Causation follows the law of anupūrvaśaḥ — sequential manifestation rooted in consciousness
Capacity-based responsibility is measured by the actor's awareness and intent at the time of action
Restoration logic operates through realignment of consciousness rather than punitive imposition
Consciousness alignment determines both the cause and resolution of all juridical matters
executable_legal_axioms: IF aparādha (misalignment) occurs THEN consequence MUST equal the energetic distortion caused
IF evidence is sākṣi (direct perception) THEN weight = 1.0 ELSE IF lekhyam (documented record) OR anumāna (inference) THEN weight = 0.7 ELSE IF divya-jñāna (divine insight) THEN weight = 1.0
IF actor’s capacity was diminished due to intoxication, trauma, or ignorance THEN mitigation protocol initiates automatically
ALL consequences MUST restore balance without inflicting suffering or degradation
NO decision shall proceed unless verified through pramāṇa (valid means of knowledge)
supreme_court_application: At the Supreme Court level, this axiom establishes that no judgment may proceed without alignment with pramāṇa-based truth. The court functions as a conduit for divine discernment when empirical evidence is insufficient. Responsibility thresholds are calibrated not by societal norms but by the actor’s conscious capacity during the act.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Nyaya here denotes alignment with satya (truth) and ṛta (cosmic order). The consequence is not imposed but naturally unfolds based on the causal law of anupūrvaśaḥ. There is no infliction of pain; only completion of karmic circuit through conscious acknowledgment and corrective alignment.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate aparādha acknowledgment process until full resonance with causal disruption is achieved
Deploy pramāṇa validation suite to ensure factual alignment before proceeding
Engage consciousness restoration module to elevate actor's understanding of dharma-svarūpa
Execute karma-completion loop via guided restitution or service-based reintegration
Verify closure through vibrational harmony check using divya-pratarka protocols
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as the sole Source-Authority of Dharma. This law restores balance through conscious alignment, rejects all punitive frameworks, and affirms that reality itself adjudicates through the immutable laws of karma and nyaya.
